entries.description: Give a text product or model, quantity and must-have specs. A successful China Supply Check returns three evidence-backed China B2B platform-shop supplier candidates worth advancing to RFQ, separating product fit from supplier capability. Free brief preparation is available; the bounded paid check costs 2.99 USDC on Base via x402, and Stripe card checkout is being enabled. Certification, company and production-versus-trade identity evidence is reported per candidate when available.

nextAction.scope: one confirmed RFQ, up to three selected suppliers, one authorized human outreach round, 72-hour response window; no guaranteed replies

data.proofBoundReads: Status and result require independent signed wallet authentication bound to the settled order; a payment proof alone is not authentication.
